title: img2threejs: Turn Photos into 3D Models from Code Only
description:
img2threejs turns a single photo into a browser-ready 3D model made entirely from Three.js code. Give it one reference image and it writes the model using basic shapes and shaders, ready to animate. Works with Claude Code and Codex.
